Anyone could assume this role.

  Anyone                unknown  grant 1  Anyone could assume this role: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com gives tokens to guests and to whoever signs in.
  Anyone on a platform  exact             No grant is placed at a whole platform.
  A named outsider      exact             No grant is placed with a named outsider.
  Your pipelines        exact             No grant is confined to owners declared as yours.
  Your people           exact             No grant trusts a SAML provider declared as yours.

Each of these can narrow the rings and was not read: the organisation's resource control policies, the calling accounts' service control policies, this account's identity providers and the settings of each audience this role accepts from cognito-identity.amazonaws.com.

grant 1 of 1 · statement[0] "IdentityPoolGuests" · Allow · https://cognito-identity.amazonaws.com · anyone · unknown
This role admits any token from cognito-identity.amazonaws.com whose amr was not evaluated and whose aud is us-east-1:12345678-abcd-abcd-abcd-123456789012, so the set shown is an upper bound.
The set shown is an upper bound, not the set: a token not excluded here may still be refused by AWS.
